items.title: Etale morphisms lift uniquely to universal first order thickenings and reflect the universal property
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For composable morphisms of algebraic spaces with the first etale, the lemma gives two statements: an etale morphism lifts uniquely to a morphism between the universal first order thickenings, and if the lift is etale and surjective then the universal property descends to the base. The proof uses the topological invariance of the etale site to produce the unique lift of the etale morphism, and then compares the universal properties of the two thickenings through that lift. Producing the unique lift via topological invariance is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 3043-3069.
